# Local workspace companion source

Source: [sdwhwzp/dsh-passwords](https://github.com/sdwhwzp/dsh-passwords), commit `0ea4cc4`. The original repository's `LICENSE` contains GPL version 3; that text is preserved in `COPYING`. The package manifest's different license label is not used to relabel these files.

The five TypeScript files are pinned source copies. Local changes to `local-workspace-cli.ts` remove automatic CLI startup, reject already-cancelled shell calls before spawning, and terminate the POSIX command group even if its shell leader exits before its descendants. `executeOperation` is exported upstream, so that former local change has retired. `local-workspace-protocol.ts`, `local-workspace-browser.ts`, `local-workspace-desktop.ts` and `local-workspace-error.ts` are unchanged. The pinned copy carries the upstream CRLF edit fix: `read` splits lines on `/\r?\n/`, so a caller quoting several lines back sends them LF-joined even when the file on disk keeps CRLF, and matching the raw text failed every multi-line edit of a Windows checkout. Synchronize from that repository, reapply the listed local edits, and run the desktop remote tests and build before updating the pin.

`src/main/remote/filesystem-worker.ts` is the GPL companion entry. The worker is a separate Electron utility process; the desktop sends one file or shell operation and receives a JSON result over process messaging. The remote client permits read, write, edit, glob, grep, read-only files browsing and bash; bash runs PowerShell on Windows and Bash on macOS as the current OS user. Office operations remain unavailable. A folder the user granted desktop control also permits screenshot and input, which observe and drive that computer's own screen rather than the authorized folder; `local-workspace-desktop.ts` runs them through PowerShell on Windows, `osascript` on macOS and `xdotool` on Linux, and refuses them outright without the grant. File operations have a 30-second deadline, desktop input 60 seconds; shell calls default to 120 seconds and accept up to 600 seconds. Worker IPC carries cancellation, allowing command-tree termination before worker exit. The desktop waits for outstanding workers during application shutdown.

Build: `npm ci && npm run build:remote` at the desktop repository root, with Node 22.21.1 or later. Electron Vite bundles the worker into `out/main/filesystem-worker.js`. Remote packages include this source directory, the worker entry, the build configuration and GPL text under `local-workspace-source`. The complete build source is available from the owned desktop fork's `dev` branch.
